scope: Retrospective research synthesis, not profitable policy selection or protected evaluation
ranking_basis: Incremental forecast value beyond contemporaneous market on chronological assessment
Mechanism isolated by matched or controlled comparisons
Net risk and execution evidence, including no-trade
Scientific value of next discriminating experiment and feasibility
ranking_caveat: Qualitative prioritization informed by the first three offline reports; not a preregistered statistical winner-selection procedure
rules: Do not pool different prompt/checkpoint families or duplicate matches
Report estimates separately from provider usage estimates and verified invoices
Directions retain separate $5 caps; unused allocations do not justify searches
Check receipt completeness and holdout guard before accepting each conclusion
